🚨 **UPDATE:** Lonn Hartman remains alive and continues to recover as investigators work to determine what happened during the incident at **Blissfest 2026**. At this time, **no arrests have been announced**, and the investigation remains active.

In this update, we review the latest publicly available information, examine statements from investigators and those close to Lonn, and discuss where the case stands today. We also look at why family, friends, and supporters continue to call for answers and transparency as authorities process evidence and pursue leads.

Our thoughts remain with Lonn Hartman, his loved ones, and everyone affected by this tragedy. This video is intended to summarize the confirmed developments, separate verified information from speculation, and encourage continued public awareness while the investigation is ongoing.
